_doc: Owner-maintained money-concept -> THE ONE canonical ledger table. Enforced by scripts/verify-no-duplicate-financial-ledger.mjs. A NEW financial table (or any table whose name-token collides with a concept below) fails CI unless its migration declares either '-- SUPERSEDES: <schema.table> (JORGE-APPROVED <YYYY-MM-DD>)' or a '-- CANONICAL-CHECK:' block that EXPLICITLY NAMES the colliding canonical table and states why the new one is distinct. Purpose: make a split-brain money ledger (e.g. a new driver_finance.cash_advances beside driver_finance.driver_advances) STRUCTURALLY UNMERGEABLE.
_add_a_concept_only_after: verifying the canonical table exists on main (LAW-OF-THE-LAND Section 0). Every path below was grep-verified against db/migrations on 2026-07-13.

_notes.factor_vs_factoring: factoring.* is the real factoring ledger (factoring.batch / reserve_movement / letter_of_release / etc.). factor.* is FARO daily-import STAGING (factor.faro_daily_imports / faro_invoice_lines / reconciliation_runs) — a DISTINCT staging area, not a second factoring ledger.
_notes.escrow: VERIFIED on main 2026-07-13: canonical escrow LEDGER TABLE = driver_finance.escrow_ledger (per-driver hold/release/forfeit, created 202606120600_d1_settlement_approval.sql; the 202607110220 repoint migration + verify:escrow-ledger-fk-canonical guard treat it as canonical). Related distinct sub-concepts (NOT duplicates): driver_finance.driver_escrow_separations (separation/return flow), driver_finance.escrow_balances (per-driver running balance), accounting.escrow_postings (GL projection). The escrow LIABILITY posts to the Damage-Claim escrow liability GL ACCOUNT (QBO-1150040187) — an account row, not a ledger table — which is distinct from the Faro factoring-reserve asset account (QBO-1150040084); the settlement pay-run escrow resolver must pin to the Damage-Claim liability, never Faro. ACCT-R-01 (2026-07-25): the two balances (driver_finance.escrow_balances.current_balance_cents = operational; accounting.escrow_accounts.balance_cents = GL-linked liability read by releaseDriverEscrowSeparation()) were found OUT OF SYNC — contributions never updated the GL balance, so separation releases would compute $0. Fixed by accounting/escrow/service.ts's recordEscrowPostingOnly(), called from both driver_finance writers; guarded by scripts/verify-acct-r01-escrow-canonical-write-path.mjs (verify-step 1489). See docs/specs/DESIGN-HOLD-0007-ESCROW-SPLIT-BRAIN-2026-07-21.md 'ACCT-R-01 update'.
_notes.payment_method: driver_finance.driver_payment_methods is the per-driver method row. The future owner-editable catalogs.payment_methods CATALOG (settlement pay-run build) is distinct: driver_payment_methods will reference it. A new catalogs.payment_methods must therefore carry a CANONICAL-CHECK that names driver_payment_methods and states the catalog-vs-per-driver distinction.
